answer_1.quote: We select four datasets dedicated to question-answering tasks-QuALITY , Qasper , NarrativeQA , and Hot-potQA )-along with one for summarization, QMSum.
answer_1.outputs: generated answers to questions and summaries

answer_2.quote: For QuALITY, we report the exact match (EM) score. For QMSum, we report the geometric mean of ROUGE scores. For the remaining datasets (Qasper, NarrativeQA, and HotpotQA), we report the F1 scores.
